description: Per-card status of a deck list (deck id or name). deck.commanders names who leads it (one card, or a pair); deck.companion names its companion, or null; its row is the sideboard row with is_companion (outside the 100 in a commander format); deck.editable false: the deck is past the decks the user's plan keeps editable, and a change to it answers PLAN_LIMIT. sections counts main (commander included) and sideboard. Each row: its section, is_commander, wanted quantity and how it is covered — allocated (this deck's own copies), shared_in (copies deliberately shared from other decks — ALWAYS disclose these with which decks share them and where the cards physically are), claimable (free copies exist in the collection), missing. sleeved counts the allocated (own) copies that are physically in the deck; the other allocated copies are staged, still where they were. Row status is the strongest complete coverage: allocated > shared_in > claimable > missing. also_shared_with lists this deck's OWN copies that another deck also claims as shared: the two decks cannot be played at the same time — ALWAYS disclose these too, with the other deck and where the card physically is. A row with missing > 0 may carry held_elsewhere: copies the user DOES own that another deck claims (deck, where they are, is_proxy). Never call such a card "not owned": say it is in that deck, and that claim_from_collection with allow_shared:true would share it. deck.play tournament: a copy only a proxy covers counts as missing, and proxies_missing says how many of a row's missing copies the deck plays as proxies: say "you play a proxy; a tournament needs the real card". On a casual deck proxies count as covered.
name: deck_status

image_uri.description: The card's picture on Scryfall, to show as it is; null when the catalogue has none

scryfall_url.description: The card's page on Scryfall: link the card's name to it

scryfall_url.description: The card's page on Scryfall: link the card's name to it

companion.description: The companion, or null: a sideboard row, outside the 100 in a commander format. deck_health checks its condition

editable.description: False: past the decks the user's plan keeps editable; a change answers PLAN_LIMIT

lang.description: The language the deck's rows ask for unless a row has its own; null any

open_to_trade.description: True: its claimed copies are on every tradelist the user publishes, each naming this deck. Say so

play.description: How the deck is played. tournament: a copy only a proxy covers counts as missing, until a real copy replaces it. casual: proxies play, and a deck with proxies is not tournament legal: say so

proxies_missing.description: Of missing, on a tournament deck: copies it plays as proxies. Say so

also_shared_with.description: This deck's own copies another deck also claims as shared: the two decks cannot be played at once. Always disclose.

claimable.description: Free copies in the collection: not missing. On a tournament deck, real copies only

held_elsewhere.description: On a row with copies missing: copies the user owns that another deck claims. Never call the card "not owned".

is_proxy.description: A proxy is not a real card: say so

image_uri.description: The row's picture on Scryfall, to show as it is: the printing the row pins, else one printing of the card; null when the catalogue has none

is_companion.description: This sideboard row is the deck's companion

lang.description: The row's own language, Scryfall's code (de, ja, zhs…); null follows the deck's

lang_asked.description: The language the row asks for: its own, else the deck's; null any. A preference: a copy in another language still counts

missing.description: On a tournament deck this counts copies only a proxy covers: see proxies_missing

pinned_scryfall_id.description: The printing the row pins; null: any printing

proxies_allocated.description: Claimed copies that are proxies: always say so

proxies_missing.description: Of missing, on a tournament deck: copies the deck plays as a proxy. Say so: "you play a proxy; a tournament needs the real card". 0 on a casual deck

scryfall_url.description: The card's page on Scryfall: link the card's name to it

shared_detail.description: Borrowed copies: which other decks also claim them and where they physically are. Always disclose.

shared_in.description: Copies borrowed as shared from other decks: always disclose, with shared_detail

sleeved.description: Of allocated: copies physically in the deck; the rest are staged, still where they were
